data.name: Until Dusk!
data.detailed_description:
Until Dusk (Demo) is a fast-paced arcade zombie shooter where every round turns up the pressure.

Fight through relentless waves of undead, complete dangerous objectives, earn powerful rewards, and survive as long as you can in a stylized military-themed battlefield overrun by chaos. The deeper you go, the harder the horde hits.

Built around nonstop action and that addictive “one more round” feeling, Until Dusk throws you into intense survival combat where quick movement, fast shooting, and smart decisions are the only things keeping you alive. Hold your ground, clear infested zones, chase objectives under pressure, and unleash devastating support when the odds start to slip.

The zombies do not stop coming. The pressure does not let up. Survive long enough to become a one-person war machine.

Fight fast. Hold the line. Survive Until Dusk.

Key Features

  • Fast-paced round-based zombie survival

  • Dynamic objectives that keep every run intense

  • Escalating waves and rising difficulty

  • Reward-driven arcade progression

  • Powerful support drops and high-impact pickups

  • Rare Golden Cache event with exclusive rewards

  • Audio log collectibles and collection menu

  • Player stats tracking

  • Full player profiles and online leaderboards in the full release

  • Stylized military-inspired action

Wishlist now on Steam to stay up to date with the full release of Until Dusk!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500/7600 or Intel Core i5-13400/14400 (6-core/12-thread or higher)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 Ti / RTX 4070 or AMD RX 6600 XT / RX 7700 XT (8GB+ VRAM)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
